name: Rhapsody Shindigger
summary: At the Aerie Peak Aviary, Talonaxe has news of a fallen flyer. Rhapsody Shindigger was once its finest flyer, but liquor cost Rhapsody the post. Now Rhapsody keeps a brewing camp east of the aviary, in the Hinterlands, Talonaxe has heard.

sections.title: A Fallen Flyer
sections.body:
Gryphon Master Talonaxe says the aviary dwarves all enjoy a good ale. Rhapsody took to liquor as readily as a gryphon takes to the skies. No one could fly like Rhapsody, and Talonaxe still regrets the loss.

The trouble began when Rhapsody returned stumbling from a trip with Brohann. Things worsened quickly, and the aviary let Rhapsody go. Talonaxe’s last word is that Rhapsody now keeps a brew camp east of Aerie Peak.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Rhapsody Shindigger?
faq.answer: Gryphon Master Talonaxe at the Aerie Peak Aviary sends you to find Rhapsody.

faq.q: Why was Rhapsody Shindigger let go from the aviary?
faq.answer: Rhapsody took to liquor as readily as a gryphon takes to the skies. Trouble began when Rhapsody returned stumbling from a flight with Brohann, then worsened quickly until the aviary let Rhapsody go.
Talonaxe has heard that Rhapsody now keeps a brew camp east of the aviary, in the Hinterlands.
